verdict.rationale: Unity documents command-line launch of the Editor and Player for automating workflows, a Player headless mode, and -batchmode/-nographics for headless CI builds. It also ships a first-party Unity CLI aimed at CI and build agents, with structured JSON/TSV output and documented exit codes, plus the hosted Build Automation CI service. One community report says seat licensing costs blocked a CI build server, which is a cost barrier rather than a capability failure. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of a headless CI run, and the standalone CLI is still experimental.
